About this page

This page was first published in May 2017 as a redesigned successor of the original At A Glance: UK General Election 2015 pages published in May 2015. Information on this page may change as a result of any inaccuracies identified. Key sources of data for this page includeParliament.uk, theParliament UK BETAsite, theElectoral Commission,Wikipediaand theBBC.

This page uses a modified version ofMixItUpfromKunka Labs.
